summary.name: MediSearch
summary.one_liner: MediSearch is an AI search tool that gives evidence-based, science-backed answers to medical and health questions.
use_cases: Checking whether a lifestyle habit affects health
Researching risks of a medical procedure
Finding evidence on diet and cholesterol
Getting science-based answers to common health questions
Exploring complex questions about medications or vaccines
summary.what_it_does: The page presents MediSearch as a search engine and chatbot for medical questions, promising direct, evidence-based answers. It shows example questions grouped into common questions (e.g., whether coffee or alcohol is beneficial) and more complex ones (e.g., meniscectomy outcomes, creatine and cognition). It has filters and a "Try Pro" option, suggesting a paid tier exists. The page text itself does not describe the sources, methodology, or answer format in detail.
notable: Answers framed as evidence-based and science-based
Pro tier offered alongside a free search
Business offering listed on the site
caveats: Pro tier features and pricing are not detailed on the page
Sources and methodology for answers are not described in the page text
Not a substitute for professional medical advice (implied by medical nature; not explicitly stated)
